business_problem: Lumen needed to join diagnostic, performance, and ticketing data because siloed systems and outdated logic were slowing issue resolution and technician onboarding for enterprise customers.
solution_summary: Lumen Technologies uses Azure Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Model Serving, Llama 3.3, and Agent Bricks AI Playground to support GenAI ticket summarization and diagnostics for field technicians. Lumen needed to join diagnostic, performance, and ticketing data because siloed systems and outdated logic were slowing issue resolution and technician onboarding for enterprise customers. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Agent Bricks AI Playground, runs transformation or AI logic on Azure Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks Model Serving. Tickets, conversation history, knowledge articles, and operational context are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; pipeline execution is coordinated with Agent Bricks AI Playground; Azure Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks Model Serving.
business_outcome: Lumen Technologies improved GenAI ticket summarization and diagnostics for field technicians and created measurable gains in productivity improvement, customer experience, scalability, and cost reduction through the new platform.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance and lineage are enforced through Unity Catalog.
The platform is designed for near-real-time or streaming analysis rather than batch-only reporting.
